item.text: {"summary":"Draft is broadly publishable on resolver, prior, and target logic, but it needs fixes for a likely country-field mismatch and an unsupported interval-volatility calculation.","requiredFixes":[{"rubricItem":"coherence","severity":"blocking","summary":"The JSON field \"country\":\"EA\" conflicts with the Belgium target and title/question.","actionRequested":"Change the country/geography field to the repository's Belgium value, likely \"BE\" or \"Belgium\", while keeping the same catalog slug and target."},{"rubricItem":"interval","severity":"warning","summary":"The stated sigma = 0.14 is not clearly supported by the listed 2025-06 to 2026-05 monthly sequence, whose rounded month-to-month changes appear much smaller.","actionRequested":"Recompute the interval dispersion from the stated historical sample or explicitly label the 0.2 half-width as a judgmental/rounding first-print uncertainty allowance rather than a direct realized-volatility result."}],"optionalSuggestions":["State explicitly that the forecast is two months ahead from the latest May 2026 observation to July 2026, since June is not yet used.","If the schema expects ISO-like country codes, prefer a canonical country value and avoid euro-area shorthand in Belgium-specific records."]}
